IRREVERENTS — START HERE

A living game-design vision library \| Baseline assembled 22 November 2026

# What is Irreverents?

A richly interconnected 2D side-scrolling, Amazing Mirror-inspired action-adventure about a shared party of radically curious, gleefully irreverent heroes whose favorite activity is disrupting a world that takes its stories and prophecies very seriously.

Explore secret worlds; recruit a growing LEGO-style roster; copy temporary powers from enemies; play online cooperatively; master stealth or deliberately provoke overwhelming, spectacular resistance; steal vehicles, cause mayhem, survive impossible escapes, and earn immortalized records in a playable Hall of Legends.

# Current creative north star

The world is important to itself. The heroes are fascinated by everything except the supposedly important quest. Players are free to save a town, rob its jewels, unleash chaos, flee pursuit, help the townspeople survive the consequences, and revisit later with completely new capabilities.

The emotional standard is the “OHHHHH” moment of spectacular physical IMPACT, balanced by the profound satisfaction of an impossible zero-alarm infiltration. A disastrous stealth attempt should often become an even more memorable battle or escape.

# Status rules

CONFIRMED = directly requested or chosen by the project owner.

STRONG DIRECTION = clear shared intent whose details remain open.

EXAMPLE = illustrative scenario, provisional name, mockup graphic or candidate ability.

OPEN = team design, technical, production, testing or owner decision outstanding.

Only the Decision Register authorizes a brainstorm example as a firm requirement. If a speculative example appears in a doc, it must remain labeled accordingly.

# Invariants for designers

- Do not make the central quest more important to the gameplay than the player finds it.

- Do not remove meaningful stealth as the price of having fun chaos.

- Do not make triggering an alarm an automatic bad outcome.

- Do not simplify combat down to damage numbers; collision force and consequence are essential.

- Do not confine mayhem to designated levels or protect the Hall of Legends from gameplay.

- Do not force a human-co-op requirement where consistent mechanics permit a clever solo workaround.

- Do not let one tough boss gate most of the world.

- Do not turn the Hall into a preset achievements checklist instead of a memory of actual events.

- Do not treat generated character art or names as approved canon.

# What this baseline is and is not

This is a comprehensive vision-level handoff of decisions and reference assets gathered so far. It is not a production-ready GDD with final mechanics tables, maps, engine architecture, animation spec, asset budgets, narrative script, network infrastructure or release roadmap. The Decision Register enumerates the unresolved questions so a dev team can make responsible proposals without silently inventing approvals.

NEW CONFIRMED WORLD PREMISE — THE SACRED SCRIPT (22 NOV 2026)

The whole world treats the Hero's Journey as a religion and wants every person and object to fulfill an exactly predictable, glorious, profoundly meaningful role in the main story. Everybody is fiercely typecast; everything is for exactly what it appears to be for. The heroes' creativity and irreverence disrupt this rigid culture in ways most inhabitants genuinely resent or fear. This is a core direction, NOT a speculative proposal; specific religion names/organizations remain open.

Detailed document 21: https://docs.google.com/document/d/16hzOOStE4Nt-uOcD6ApTDbWPT10fgizTC3eOcDB8Vmw/edit

LATEST TONE LOCK — JOYFUL ROLE-PRIDE (22 NOV 2026)

Everyone in this sacred-Hero's-Journey civilization is truly DELIGHTED to play their typecast role. The shopkeeper is incredibly proud to be a storekeeper. NPCs are not cynical, trapped or merely going through motions; they enthusiastically relish the predictable, meaningful main-story world. The irreverent player party is disruptive not because it is saving them from roles, but because it treats sacred, single-purpose things as toys for alternative possibilities. Updated canonical premise: https://docs.google.com/document/d/16hzOOStE4Nt-uOcD6ApTDbWPT10fgizTC3eOcDB8Vmw/edit

NEW CORE GAMEPLAY MECHANIC — NARRATIVE DISSONANCE (22 NOV 2026)

Owner-confirmed: NPCs are horrified by heroes doing anything other than the obvious expected glorious thing, which produces disproportionately intense resistance. But once the heroes resume ordinary role-appropriate behavior, the world becomes reassured astonishingly fast: “Yup! Just as expected!” This dual loop creates social stealth and an original pursuit escape method. Immediate calming and long-term records can coexist; exact boundaries are OPEN. Core system document: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1jQssgW8w1oXo_14lLhbGHVwWTPef7y2TEU_aCD_nMvQ/edit

CORE ESCALATION RULE — OWNER CONFIRMED 22 NOV 2026

The sacred-story culture assumes unusual behavior is a temporary fluke. Persistent deviation compounds COGNITIVE DISSONANCE and distress, eventually drawing even proud storekeepers, civilians and pet cats into a desperate effort to stop the heroes; the crowd can become overwhelming though its members are not powerful fighters. Normal role-appropriate action can then reassure and pacify the community with remarkable speed. This is the emotional foundation of escalation and de-escalation, beyond a generic wanted meter. Detailed: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1jQssgW8w1oXo_14lLhbGHVwWTPef7y2TEU_aCD_nMvQ/edit

NEW CANONICAL NPC BEHAVIOR — THREE MODES (22 NOV 2026)

Every inhabitant, including villains, generally uses THREE modes: Business as Usual, Confusion/Distress, Absolute Blinding Violent Rage. Business as Usual is correct SCRIPT PERFORMANCE, even if that means confronting a villain; a merchant is COMFORTABLE opposing an expected villainous robbery, but horrified by a villain shopping politely. Repeated role violation triggers distress then rage, whereas recognizable role performance can rapidly calm an NPC. This supersedes any earlier proposed six-stage model as the top-level behavior classification. Detailed mechanics: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1wuGuCu1RhXXhdWuU55ZcJJ8rZAbCx98mZfdqsyrgMv8/edit

D&D ETHOS CLARIFIED — OWNER CONFIRMED 22 NOV 2026

The game's cultural foundation also pays homage to CHAOTIC NEUTRAL and the tabletop RULE OF COOL. The protagonists ask “What would be epic?” instead of accepting the prescribed heroic role; systems should welcome inventive, playful, surprising actions and their consequences without guaranteeing success. This is NOT random cruelty, a simplistic morality meter, or obligation to disrupt every scene. Relevant confirmed decisions: D-052 to D-054 in the Decision Register.

NEW PRODUCTION FEASIBILITY PROPOSAL — 22 NOV 2026

A pragmatic implementation strategy now describes how to make Irreverents playable WITHOUT building a vast AI simulation: finite action tags, reusable physical affordances, one shared 3-mode archetypal NPC system, authored nonlinear rooms, limited elite/crowd reactions, simple grab/knockback/destructibles, phased Hall capture, and staged co-op/network complexity. A small graybox vertical slice tests whether the idea feels magical before broad world expansion. This is PROPOSED design, not an owner-approved technical commitment. https://docs.google.com/document/d/1WdIyj6OrTzMhXD842nIJ4iIlQYlFuQQiwxNj2ygIyYM/edit

NPC IMPLEMENTATION LOCK — 22 NOV 2026

Owner explicitly confirmed: NONE OF THE NPCs HAVE AI. The three-mode archetypal NPC behaviors, including shopkeeper versus villain interactions and escalation/rapid pacification, are entirely authored game events and scripted deterministic responses. Do not infer individual agents, autonomous reasoning or learning. Updated feasibility spec: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1WdIyj6OrTzMhXD842nIJ4iIlQYlFuQQiwxNj2ygIyYM/edit

NEW PLAYABLE LEVEL ANTHOLOGY — 22 NOV 2026

Twelve proposed Kirby/LEGO-inspired side-scrolling location clusters, each with conventional routes, stealth opportunities, escalating scripted NPC reactions, co-op-friendly puzzle affordances, possible solo workarounds, secrets, revisit unlocks and construction economies. Levels are INTEGRATED into the connected world, not stage-select missions. Region names, exact content and mechanic counts are creative PROPOSALS, not locked canon. Anthology: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1NtE6Be9LX5uOd6ditYwN0UPeSbhEefEW4SJ75NVFGf0/edit

IMPORTANT OWNER TONAL LOCK — GAMEPLAY BEFORE JOKE (22 NOV 2026)

The inspired game experience is Kirby/LEGO-style gameplay, with VERY LITTLE DIALOGUE. Do not force lore, named sacred-quest themes, long NPC dialogue or repeated Hero's Journey jokes into every level. NPC archetypes and reactions support surprising player-led situations as an underlying world behavior. Most rooms should simply be excellent side-scrolling platforming, secrets, co-op puzzles, stealth and combat spaces. The earlier 12-level anthology overemphasized themed narrative and is now flagged with a tone override. Level mechanics remain exploratory. See: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1NtE6Be9LX5uOd6ditYwN0UPeSbhEefEW4SJ75NVFGf0/edit

CORE COMBAT DESIGN — TWO DISTINCT ESCALATION SYSTEMS (22 NOV 2026)

Attacking expected good guys triggers scaling SOCIAL COUNTEROFFENSE via scripted NPC narrative-distress/rage. Fighting bad guys is normal heroic-versus-villainous conflict; bad guys appear scattered throughout levels, and certain hostile OUTPOSTS have SIGNALERS that can call escalating reinforcement waves. An enemy must detect a player, recognize a threat, reach and activate a signaler. Players can avoid detection, destroy/disable signalers, intercept callers, clear enemies before more calls, or escape the area. While players allow ongoing signaling, waves can recur endlessly; never turn discovery into an automatic fail/reload. NO NPC AI and little dialogue: scripted routes, alarms, waves, sounds and sprite actions tell the story. Full design details: https://docs.google.com/document/d/11sUrQ0eFfjXi_inoYBFnYGJ6FA_IAc5fJeKfru5KDIQ/edit

LATEST ESCALATION RULE — WITNESS → CALL → WANTED/REINFORCEMENTS (22 NOV 2026)

Owner-confirmed correction to both earlier escalation systems: NO SCALING BACKUP without somebody successfully signaling for help. Good NPCs only call in mode 2 distress or 3 rage. Knock out an isolated shopkeeper before they report, with no witnesses, and the player can rob the shop and leave without outside response. A later discoverer of the unconscious shopkeeper may become alert and report; detection alone does not dispatch. Individual NPC emotion is distinct from a shared GTA/NFS-inspired wanted level; follow-on calls raise pursuing forces. Bad-guy outpost calls retain the detect-threat/reach-signaler/activate prerequisites. All NPC behaviors are scripted, with essentially no dialogue. Full specification: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1wbSNfKLfrUsg9YX5qsRhYX9KwiMX8clXRZZBiuuz8PA/edit

VILLAIN OUTPOST ALARMS — OWNER-CONFIRMED CLARIFICATION (22 NOV 2026)

Bad guys use horn/bell/beacon/alarm signalers upon recognizing a hero as a THREAT, even when they remain delightedly in mode 1 Business As Usual. Good-guy reporting remains reserved for modes 2/3. No reinforcements spawn until a signal is actually completed. Inspirations: Zelda BOTW/TOTK lookout horns and Far Cry 5 alarms. Both systems use scripted behaviors, not NPC AI. The earlier villain-distress-mode ambiguity has been resolved. See the wanted/reporting specification: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1wbSNfKLfrUsg9YX5qsRhYX9KwiMX8clXRZZBiuuz8PA/edit

PLAYABLE PURSUITS THROUGH CONNECTED LEVELS (22 NOV 2026)

An already-reported good-guy pursuit is increasingly sticky: defending/fighting refreshes or raises heat, and the player must actually disengage, hide and evade for enough time to cool down. Guards can pursue players across physical level boundaries into hostile enemy territory, causing guard-versus-villain collisions and three-sided combat. Entirely scripted NPC behaviors, no omniscient arrival of reinforcements. Dedicated design document: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1RMdB5x9k3wfVKolnYhZLtuwLYrm3lmrO1w6fpjCy7po/edit

DE-ESCALATION THRESHOLD — OWNER-CONFIRMED 22 NOV 2026

For GOOD GUYS, mode 2 confusion/distress can be quickly pacified by returning to the expected script. But mode 3 violent rage CANNOT be reversed that way: players must fully disengage, avoid the good guys, and make no attacks (including defensive), no destruction and no further unexpected incidents for long enough that GENERAL ALARM/HEAT drops below violent level. Only then can normal reassurance work again. Distant reinforcements still require an actual completed report. This correction supersedes earlier scene sketches where a raging crowd instantly forgave a player making a purchase. Full spec: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1wbSNfKLfrUsg9YX5qsRhYX9KwiMX8clXRZZBiuuz8PA/edit

PURSUIT GEOGRAPHY — OWNER DIRECTION 22 NOV 2026

When good guys reach the violent/wanted pursuit state, most reliable exit is finding a physically hard-to-reach refuge and hiding quietly long enough for alarm to cool. Between-level playable connectors have FEW such safe spots, making flight across the overworld dangerous; players may need to reach real levels with more complex hiding geometry. Guards can follow across level borders, so loading a new room alone is no escape. No AI, no automatic instant cooldown.

NEW LEVEL DESIGN PROPOSALS — 22 NOV 2026

Ten additional GAMEPLAY-FIRST side-scrolling regions are fleshed out in 28 — Ten More Gameplay-First Level Designs: Iron Quarry, Shipbreaker Cove, City Clocktower, Moonlit Conservatory, Prism Spires, Frostline Express, Mushroom Hollows, Old Theatre, Bone Causeway, Dormant Colossus. Proposals, not canon. They prioritize traversal, enemy patterns, copied powers, secrets, reasonable solo/co-op puzzles, optional stealth, physical signaling for reinforcement waves, persistent guard pursuits into hostile factions, and rare refuge spots in exposed between-level connectors. Little dialogue; no NPC AI; minimal forced lore. https://docs.google.com/document/d/1tvbPY5po9I6XitnlNzVrE8UH7ihgU8rIjSr_CBuHyko/edit

LEVEL COMPLETION — OWNER-FAVORED DIRECTION (22 NOV 2026)

Like LEGO Star Wars, substantial playable levels should track discovery/completeness. The player wants hidden COMPONENTS, collected separately across a level, that eventually BUILD AN UNKNOWN THING; the creation is a surprise. An EXPLORED PERCENTAGE can tell the player that geography is still missing without disclosing which secret or where. Keep the simple gameplay-first, non-expository style, and make region progress naturally persist across revisits and new-character abilities. Exact counters, counts, assembly/reward content and completion UI remain PROPOSALS. Design: https://docs.google.com/document/d/13cnvLDsV6ILLs_yc202HENUSVKYMiMcHpmZpMXvpeoc/edit

RARE RECOVERABLE POWERS — OWNER DIRECTION 22 NOV 2026

Certain abilities and items are exceptionally rare and come from a few KNOWN LOCATIONS. The player can carry them between levels, lose them, and revisit the original sources to obtain them again. Kirby-like combat hits can eject stolen/copied powers and possibly some carried items. This adds stakes to stealth, combat, and travel, and makes shortcuts and geographic knowledge practically rewarding. Permanent character unlocks and completion progress should not be conflated with the temporary loadout. Recovery time, drop conditions, equip rules and source respawn remain OPEN. Design: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1puHJwUoNnBkNZyTLCh01VRQiqzUzjnb7plYfni9e2Gw/edit

CANTINA — OWNER-CONFIRMED HUB AND ENDLESS ARENA (22 NOV 2026)

The BETWEEN-LEVEL world includes a CANTINA where ALL UNLOCKED playable characters hang out/wander. Here the party can be reconfigured by TAPPING a roaming candidate, seeing the CURRENT PARTY appear ACROSS THE SCREEN, and TAPPING the active member to SWAP OUT. Separately, ATTACKING these characters begins a huge SUPER SMASH BROS.-STYLE BAR FIGHT. Players and game-controlled playable characters can be KO'd/launched offscreen and RESPAWN ENDLESSLY. K/D is tracked live for high scores. This special arena is COMPLETELY OUTSIDE THE USUAL NPC SOCIAL/ALARM/WANTED SYSTEMS, with no normal penalties, and remains NO NPC AI (scripted arena fighters). More: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1r7D8pXDPNtablfb9r8BOWWrxO6czv0hqHqLjsD8kRKU/edit

CANTINA DOOR NETWORK / COMPLETION OVERRIDE (22 NOV 2026)

The cantina has a MAIN DOOR and many SHORTCUT DOORS throughout the BETWEEN-LEVEL world. Normally, if heroes are actively CHASED BY GOOD GUYS, EVERY cantina entrance is LOCKED: you cannot use it as a getaway or cooldown exploit. One particular late-game unlock, awarded after FINDING ALL MYSTERY COMPONENTS, removes this restriction. Chased players then may enter the cantina, BUT THEIR GOOD-GUY PURSUERS CAN FOLLOW THEM INSIDE and clash with infinitely respawning cantina playable-character fighters, yielding huge mixed bar fights. This does not reset wanted heat. The collection's ultimate purpose, other rewards, precise threshold and outsiders' KO/scoring rules remain open. Canonical design: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1r7D8pXDPNtablfb9r8BOWWrxO6czv0hqHqLjsD8kRKU/edit
